name: Marrakech Ménara Airport

runway.v: one runway, 10/28, 3,100 m long and 45 m wide

hours.v: air traffic services 24 hours; airport administration office Monday to Friday 08:30-16:30 local

handling.v: handling is mandatory for business and general aviation
handling.quote: Assistance en escale obligatoire pour l'aviation d'affaires et générale

fuel.v: Jet A1 and Avgas 100LL, fuelling 24 hours

ppr.v: every night stop needs the aerodrome commander's authorisation 24 hours ahead (scheduled flights and Royal liaison aircraft exempt)
ppr.quote: Tout night stop devra faire l'objet d'une autorisation du commandant d'aérodrome 24 heures à l'avance.

notes: The night-stop rule is about aircraft parking overnight, not a ban on night movements; no curfew text was found, but the AIP does not say 'no curfew', so curfew stays unverified. De-icing is listed as NIL. Handlers listed in AD 2.23 include Jetex Executive Aviation Morocco, Swissport and RAM Handling (list, not one quotable sentence). Pages carry AIRAC AMDT 13/24 (26 Dec 2024) and AMDT 09/25 (04 Sep 2025) for AD 2.8/2.12/2.13. The live eAIP file was read; 2026 amendments 02/26, 03/26 and 06/26 exist but the GEN 0.4 page checklist could not be opened to confirm no later GMMX change. Runway direction 10/28, PCN and aircraft-over-35 t U-turn rule are in AD 2.12/2.20. Aircraft without radio are prohibited.
